A new haul-road resurfacing plan surfaced — mixing soft/sand material into the badly hard-packed ramp road (grading alone isn't fixing it), plus a longer-term plan to build a proper graded berm road. 3. See [[daily-production-report]], [[blasting-and-drilling]], [[grading-and-road-construction]]. - An informal low-grade stockpile site visit (AI meeting note attached to a Notion task, not the Meeting Notes Database, ingested as a meeting note given its format) surfaced a cluster of dump-design and level-control gaps traced to a likely common root cause — **no confirmed formal dump design was ever done for this stockpile.** Nine action items resulted (design review, Maaden surveyor engagement, offset confirmation, dedicated ramp, level clarification via TBM, running-board control, delineator installation, sheeting-material screening). 4. See [[dump-management]] (status remains emerging). - Per the KB's non-negotiable Important References workflow (out of scope for the 50th/51st dashboard-scoped runs, applicable to this full-scope run), the two IR files deferred at index-level registration by the 50th pass were read: a 26-slide JRAR Graduate Mining Engineer Development Programme training deck on load-and-haul fundamentals (spotting time, self-spotting, cycle definitions, dispatch variance management) and its one-line forwarding email.
